summary: Iteration 44 tested Rapikan Kategori Lainnya, location gate + Analisa Pelanggan, Fonnte settings and the dims/bulk-dialog fixes. Backend: 39/39 pytest pass. Covered: uncategorized summary/preview/apply (skip+override, invalid override 400, second apply 400, no product_events), the weight/dims routes still work, dims estimate rules, POST /location (guest/customer saved, admin/store_admin not saved, lat>90 422), admin customer-locations (403 for customer and store_admin), and Fonnte GET/PUT/test/test-otp with a fake token (real api.fonnte.com returns 'token invalid') plus dev_code in mode uji. Frontend at 390px: guest with location allowed sees no lock and the position is sent once, then again after moving (watchPosition works). Guest with location denied sees location-lock with allow/help/login, and the tab bar is blocked. /login, /register and /forgot-password are not locked. The lock goes away for admin and store_admin but stays for a customer (demo). The location-privacy sentence shows on Akun. Analisa Pelanggan works (stats, ca-range chips, ca-guests toggle, Leaflet iframe map, ca-row). The Fonnte page works end to end. The catfix dialog works (summary, search, picker with search/back, untick, confirm text, Kembali) without saving. In the bulk dims dialog the error clears when typing, but the inputs still overflow their boxes (see ui_bugs). No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: Some suggestions are wrong. 'Sapu Mobil F002-1' -> kebersihan: the kebersihan regex (category_suggest.py:33) matches 'sapu' before the 'sapu mobil' interior-mobil rule (line 40), so that rule never runs. 'Pampers StarCare Dewasa' (adult) -> perawatan-bayi. 'Tas Giselle Bag' and kids 'Sepatu Sport Hits Ukuran 32' -> fashion-pria. 'Lemari Elegant Mini' -> furniture instead of pabrik-lemari-plastik. Patterns have no leading word boundary (e.g. 'mic\b' matches 'ceramic'; also 'jug', 'mug', 'wok'). Low impact because the owner reviews every row.
Setting owner_whatsapp to '' quietly falls back to the OWNER_WHATSAPP env value (6281335551252), so the owner cannot really clear the number. Check this is intended.

Rolled mattresses ('Kasur Roll Premium Spring Bed ...') and foam mattresses take their size from the name (e.g. 182x202x29). Rolled goods ship much smaller, so consider adding 'kasur roll' to _SOFT or a roll-box rule.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px each <input> is 174px wide but its bordered box is only ~103px (Panjang input x33-207 inside box x32-135; Tinggi input reaches x=430, past the 390 viewport and the dialog edge at 374). Visible symptom: the focus outline of the Panjang field spreads over the Lebar field. Root cause: ui.input (src/components/product-editor/ui.tsx:76) has flex:1 but no minWidth:0/width:'100%', so RN-web keeps the input's built-in width.

issues: At wide viewports (e.g. 1920px) the 'Izinkan lokasi' button (and 'Buka Pengaturan' outline) is left-aligned while everything else is centered. Cause: alignSelf:'stretch' + maxWidth:420 inside an alignItems:center column (location-gate.tsx:132,134). Use alignSelf:'center' + width:'100%'. Fine at 390px.
There is no 'untick all / tick all' control. An owner who wants to save only a few rows out of 218 has to untick every other row one by one.
After Simpan, the owner field keeps the raw input ('0812 3456 7890') instead of the normalized number the server returns (6281234567890).
The old fonnte-test-result for the typed token stays on screen after saving.

action_items: Fix bulk-dialog input overflow: add minWidth:0 (and width:'100%') to ui.input in src/components/product-editor/ui.tsx:76 so bulk-dim-0/1/2 fit inside their boxes at 390px.
Center the lock-screen buttons on wide viewports (location-gate.tsx styles.btn/outline: alignSelf 'center').
Optional: refine the category KEYWORDS order and word boundaries (put 'sapu mobil|karpet mobil|kipas mobil' before the kebersihan rule; adult pampers; leading \b on short tokens).
Optional: add an 'untick all' toggle to the catfix dialog; after saving Fonnte settings, show the normalized owner number in the owner field.
critical_code_review_comments: customer_location.py:39 compares history_at against now.replace(tzinfo=None). This relies on Motor returning naive datetimes; if the client is ever made tz_aware it will raise TypeError. Two pings in a row passed now.
category_suggest uncategorized() counts any product whose category is not a valid id (not only 'lainnya'). That is intended, but the banner text always says 'Lainnya'.
Unmatched routes (e.g. /cart, 404 page) do not render the lock screen. Negligible.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows work; bulk dims input overflow still present)

seed_data_creation: Backend test applied the category fix to 3 'lainnya' products. My test override wrongly set one of them, pgs-27622 'Alat Peras Buah Manual', to 'dekorasi'; I reverted it to category 'lainnya', categories [] and removed subcategory. Two products stay moved with their suggested category: pgs-33108 Alat Perajang -> peralatan-dapur, pgs-51561 Alat Pemanggang Gas Roaster -> peralatan-masak. Uncategorized count is now 218. All TEST_/UI guest customer_locations and location_history docs were deleted by owner id. The demo user's location doc was removed (it did not exist before). Fonnte settings cleared (token_enc '', owner_whatsapp '' -> env fallback).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The test file now overrides with the item's own suggested category, so it does not set wrong categories. Each run moves 3 more products out of Lainnya. Run it as a whole (xdist loadscope); running subsets with -k breaks the dependent Fonnte and uncategorized steps. UI: use browser.new_context(permissions=['geolocation'], geolocation=...) for the allowed case and a plain new_context for the denied case (state 'prompt' -> lock). Screenshots go to /app/.screenshots/.
rca_of_issue: Bulk dims overflow: RN-web TextInput renders an <input> with a built-in width of about 174px. Inside a flex row, a flex:1 child without minWidth:0 will not shrink below that width, so the input spills out of its bordered wrapper (overflow visible) and its focus outline covers the next field.
